reviews.title: ★☆☆☆☆ — Monetization Disguised as Innovation
reviews.text:
Inoreader is a masterclass in taking a relatively simple concept and burying it beneath an embarrassing obsession with monetization. They’ve somehow confused squeezing every possible dollar out of users with delivering an actual quality product.

Basic convenience is treated like a luxury, useful features are held hostage behind paywalls, and the entire experience feels engineered to sell subscriptions rather than serve readers.

There’s a difference between building a sustainable business and shamelessly nickel-and-diming your customers. Inoreader seems determined to demonstrate that difference by consistently choosing the latter.

If only they invested as much effort into user experience as they do finding new reasons to charge for it.

One star. Because apparently zero is another feature they haven’t figured out how to monetize yet.

reviews.title: Issues with returning to main feed
reviews.text: There seems to be a change in the recent version where if you’re in a sub-feed and you want to go back to the overall feed you cannot without going to a different app or your main iPad screen and then reselecting Innoreader.

reviews.title: Latest update
reviews.text: The latest update rendered the app unusable.

reviews.title: Text size cannot be adjusted
reviews.text: Does not respond to Larger Text in settings or adjusting text size in Control Center, no way to adjust text size within app

reviews.title: Font size issues
reviews.text: I would rate this app a whole lot higher except you can’t make the font on the article listing bigger. I have it set to “Huge” in the settings but it never changes.

reviews.title: No Notifs?
reviews.text:
Spent $80 on a year subscription to this hoping that i’d be able to get info I care about blared at me via iPhone notifications.  

3 weeks ago: I enabled all the topics I care about then , turned on notifications as loud as possible - sounds, badges, banner style persistent, announce notifs (on), show previews (always), prioritize notifications (on).  

Have yet to receive a single notification from this app but it does have a little “1010” red missed notification tag on its app button.  What a bummer!

reviews.title: They’ve removed export OPML option
reviews.text: Brutal to have invested the time of curating feed and find export option to have been removed hindering review options

reviews.title: Stop asking
reviews.text: I like the app.   I wish they would stop asking me to rate it every darn day.

reviews.title: Almost unusable on Apple devices
reviews.text:
Content wise it’s excellent. 

Use ability is horrible on an apple touch screen device as when ready to scroll you get the zoom in screen. Same on ipad and iphone but not on android. Tried all the supposed fixes.
